description: Two-image comparison composite on a white background, filename mysteryman.jpg. Left: a low-resolution vintage color photograph of a young slim man with thick dark hair and a heavy dark mustache, wearing a blue-gray sweater, seated against a patterned sofa. Right: a video-still of an older balding man in a dark suit, over whose face the eyes-nose-mustache region of the young man from the left photo has been digitally overlaid. The composite implies the two are the same person at different ages; neither man is named in the image.
